# Sidrena legal automation notes

Sidrena 1.0.1 development line hardens publication settings so automated cjenik generation remains before the operational 08:00 publication deadline, archive retention stays at least 30 days, at least one machine-readable CSV/XML format remains enabled, and the public REST price index remains available for automated real-time retrieval. Public HTML and manifest outputs remain optional product features rather than being forced as legal minimums.

This engineering note is CI-visible context, not end-user legal advice.
